description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for Git's pathspec matching, specifically testing case insensitive pathspec matching with ':(icase)' syntax. It sets up various repositories and tests file matching and diff commands under different conditions.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks if a certain prerequisite feature is available in the testing environment.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test suite.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified filename and message, possibly creating new files in the repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to succeed, with setup commands and expectations.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected output with actual output.
